analysis: All changes are documentation-only (docs/architecture/inference.md and docs/reference/qwen4-next-support.md). No source, protocol, crypto, key-handling, authorization or deployment code is modified. The patch to qwen4-next-support.md (hunk @@ -76,8) only extends the existing typed HTTP 400 reasoning-effort rejection (Qwen4SupportPolicy.validateReasoningContext) to all concrete Qwen3.8-27B builds and bumps the date. It describes input validation before template rendering that turns a would-be 500 jinja_template error into a 400, which is neutral or beneficial to availability and honesty of error class (no data exposure). The inference.md head text covers MTP idle upgrade/drain, sampling defaults, typical MTP acceptance, MiMo native candidate accounting, Bonsai 9B policy and the code map. It states output is approximate under typical acceptance (relevant to T-007 and T-056 on correctness not being cryptographically proven) and explicitly disclaims qualification. It states prefix-cache and SSD checkpoint identity are unchanged by sampler defaults, consistent with T-041. It also notes MiMo media is never written to disk (MemoryBackedVideoAsset) which is consistent with T-050. Only the head side of inference.md was supplied (no patch or base), so the exact diff within the file could not be isolated; documentation claims about unchanged cache identity and media-in-memory behavior could not be verified against source. No threat-model assumption is invalidated by the visible text. Next review pass: if source changes accompany this PR, verify the documented claims (cache identity unaffected by typical acceptance, validateReasoningContext applying to Qwen3.8-27B IDs, no temp-file video writes).
